benefits.zh: top something off 可以描述令服裝、餐點、活動或經歷變得完整的最後細節。
benefits.en: Top something off helps you describe the final detail that completes an outfit, meal, event or experience.

benefits.titleEn: Talk about limits and highest levels
benefits.zh: top out 可以用來描述薪金、價格、速度、數量或水平的最高點。
benefits.en: Top out helps you describe the highest possible salary, price, speed, number or level.

benefits.zh: top somebody up 可以自然地表示主動提出或替別人再添一點飲品。
benefits.en: Top somebody up is a natural way to offer or give someone a little more to drink.

benefits.titleZh: 理解 TOP 的更多意思
benefits.zh: 這些片語動詞顯示 TOP 並不只用來描述最高的位置。
benefits.en: These expressions show that TOP is not limited to describing the highest position.
